name: campaign-draft-runner
description: Build and score an evidence-backed outreach prospect pool, run a measured three-variant pitch experiment, generate approved-fact reviewer guides, audit eligibility, and create Gmail drafts only; never sends mail.

DEFAULT_LIMIT.prompt: Default number of drafts per batch.

UNCHANGED_BATCH_SKIP_ENABLED.prompt: Skip expensive live batches when the campaign fingerprint is unchanged after a clean empty review.

UNCHANGED_BATCH_FORCE_MS.prompt: Maximum time between full campaign reviews even when the fingerprint is unchanged.

CREATIVE_REVIEW_AFTER_SKIPS.prompt: Optional unchanged-cycle count that triggers a bounded creative expansion; zero disables it unless a profile overrides it.

TELEMETRY_ENABLED.prompt: Record bounded batch telemetry when telemetry-ledger is available.

TELEMETRY_TOOL.prompt: Optional telemetry tool name. Leave empty to disable telemetry.
